pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped medium-brown polygons. Edges show smooth pixel gradients with minimal sharp angularity. Patch area is significantly larger on the neck region, transitioning to high fragmentation and smaller spatial area on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: High-luminance off-white pathways forming a continuous grid. Junction nodes are wide and exhibit high topological connectivity. Pathway thickness is relatively high and consistent across the visible mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, low-amplitude serration along the visible dorsal ridge of the neck. The mane presents as a continuous dark-pixel line with a high-frequency jagged edge against the overexposed background.
